name: Magalu Cloud Virtual Machines
line: Create virtual machines and manage the guest OS and applications.

free.text: R$100 credit expires at grant-month end; CPF/CNPJ and card required

work.math: R$34.99 a month VM subtotal for 730 hours. Build time runs on the VM, but the build size needed and outside CI cost are unknown.
R$44.99 a month for 730 hours. It meets the minimum of 1 GiB. The current 100 GB of data sent out and public IP are R$0, but may change. Throughput is untested.
R$44.99 for the VM + R$94.22 for a managed database = R$139.21 a month subtotal. The database has 1 vCPU, 4 GB and 10 GB, but backup and 10 GB of private traffic costs are unknown.
